story.title: The Compliance Scent
story.logline: A woman discovers her houseplant is not growing naturally, but measuring her daily obedience.
story.theme: Conformity and control disguised as nature.
story.twist: The plant's leaves aren't green from chlorophyll, but coated in a synthetic dye that reacts to human brainwaves.
story.ending: If the room is the pot, exactly how long until our roots hit the bottom?

scenes.narration: My fern grew three inches overnight, curling toward my chest like it wanted to swallow me whole.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 25 with messy brown hair and a grey hoodie, stands in a cramped, softly lit apartment staring at a glowing green fern in a ceramic pot.
scenes.camera: Extreme close-up on the fern moving, tracking up to Maya's shocked face.

scenes.narration: I never watered it. I forgot it entirely. Yet every single frond drips with heavy, sweet liquid.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 25, messy brown hair, grey hoodie, in the cramped apartment, touching a sticky green frond with her fingertip.
scenes.camera: Medium shot, shallow depth of field focusing on the glistening leaf.

scenes.narration: The sweet smell coats my tongue, tasting like artificial mint and the metallic sting of old batteries.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 25, messy brown hair, grey hoodie, grimacing in the apartment, pulling her hand back and wiping her finger.
scenes.camera: Close-up on Maya's face, slight push in.

scenes.narration: I grab the heavy pot to hurl it out the window, but the ceramic base refuses to budge.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 25, messy brown hair, grey hoodie, straining with both hands to lift the fern pot off a wooden table.
scenes.camera: Wide angle, low-angle shot emphasizing the struggle.

scenes.narration: Roots. Thick, pale veins burst right through the solid wood table, anchoring deep into my floorboards.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 25, messy brown hair, grey hoodie, staring down in horror as thick white roots split the table surface.
scenes.camera: High-angle shot looking down at the cracking wood.

scenes.narration: My phone buzzes on the desk. A single notification reads: Growth cycle optimal. Excellent compliance.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 25, messy brown hair, grey hoodie, illuminated by a harsh phone screen showing a text alert in a dark room.
scenes.camera: Extreme close-up on the glowing phone screen.

scenes.narration: I back away slowly, but the trailing vines already wrap softly around my left ankle.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 25, messy brown hair, grey hoodie, stepping back as pale green tendrils coil tight around her sneaker.
scenes.camera: Medium tracking shot moving down to her feet.

scenes.narration: Panic spikes in my chest. Instantly, the fern blooms brilliant purple flowers that drink my fear.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 25, messy brown hair, grey hoodie, gasping as the fern abruptly opens neon purple petals in the dim room.
scenes.camera: Rapid push-in on the blooming flowers.

scenes.narration: I scrape the purple pollen from a leaf and realize it is not a plant. It is paint.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 25, messy brown hair, grey hoodie, wiping purple dust on her thumb, examining the synthetic sheen closely.
scenes.camera: Macro shot of the artificial leaf texture.

scenes.narration: If the room is the pot, exactly how long until our roots hit the bottom?
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 25, messy brown hair, grey hoodie, completely still as vines merge with her grey sleeves in the dark.
scenes.camera: Static wide shot, slowly dimming to black.

caption.hook: Your houseplant is watching you obey.
caption.title: The Compliance Scent
caption.caption: She thought it was just thriving in the corner, keeping her company in the quiet apartment. But when the green began to flake away, she saw the synthetic dye measuring every compliant breath she took. How far would you let nature bend to keep you safe?
